  let Q (k : Nat) : Prop := P (b + (k : ℤ))
  have hQ : ∃ k, Q k :=
    let ⟨z, hz⟩ := Hinh in
    let k_int : ℤ := z - b
    have h_le : b ≤ z := Hb z hz
    let k_nat : Nat := Nat.ofInt k_int
    have h_cast : (k_nat : ℤ) = k_int := by
      simp [Nat.ofInt_of_nonneg (Int.sub_nonneg_of_le h_le)]
    have h_b_plus_k_nat : b + (k_nat : ℤ) = z := by
      rw [h_cast, Int.add_sub_cancel' h_le]
    by rw [← h_b_plus_k_nat] at hz ; exact ⟨k_nat, hz⟩
  let kprops := Nat.find Q hQ
  let lb : ℤ := b + (kprops.val : Nat)
  have hP : P lb := kprops.2.1
  have hmin : ∀ z, P z → lb ≤ z :=
    take z hz,
    have h_b_le_z : b ≤ z := Hb z hz
    let k' : Nat := Nat.ofInt (z - b)
    have h_cast_k' : (k' : ℤ) = z - b := by
      simp [Nat.ofInt_of_nonneg (Int.sub_nonneg_of_le h_b_le_z)]
    have h_z_eq_b_plus_k' : z = b + (k' : ℤ) := by
      rw [← h_cast_k', Int.add_sub_cancel' h_b_le_z]
    show lb ≤ z
    by_contradiction H'
    have h_z_lt_lb : z < lb := H'
    rw [lb, h_z_eq_b_plus_k'] at h_z_lt_lb
    have h_cast_less : (k' : ℤ) < (kprops.val : ℤ) := by
